title: CacheRoute: Planned Prefix-Affinity Routing for Large-Scale LLM Serving
selection_reason: prefix cache localityとload balanceをperiodic routing planで共同最適化し、60 H100/Llama-3.3-70Bでp99 SLO下176 QPS、最強baseline比2.3x、KV hit rate 64.1%→93.2%を報告。stateful routingとKV localityの実運用系として重要。
